title: Smooth Sailing through Spherical Shells: Provable Random-Lattice Sieving in Time $2^{0.292n}$
summary: In an attempt to close the gap between the best provable and heuristic algorithms for hard lattice problems, such as the shortest (SVP) and closest vector problem (CVP), we analyze lattice sieving on Haar-random unimodular lattices. With well-chosen modifications to heuristic sieving, we show that the heuristic assumptions are no longer necessary, and we can provably achieve the same complexities as heuristic sieving on Haar-random lattices for various lattice problems.
